comment: Gateway server certificate with the full chain, netscaler-nitro Deploy-NsCertificates.ps1 BEFORE 11-entra-sso-gateway.json. Skip this file if an ACME client installs the certkey gateway_example_org itself. Let's Encrypt Y generation: leaf <- YR1/YR2 <- Root YR cross-signed by ISRG Root X1 (from the full chain of the ACME order) - never end the chain at the self-signed Root YR, Workspace app builds it to ISRG Root X1. Certificate and key files stay outside the repo (certs/ is git-ignored); never put the key password on a command line.
